Ford Transit 2020 Commercial Vehicle Wrap

Having a business automatically turns you into a marketer or at least someone who tries to be one. You find yourself getting intrigued by new ideas and think about how you can use those ideas to take your business to the next level. You look for opportunities that promise growth at an affordable price.

Do you relate to any of it? We’ve got an idea for you that promises long-term advertising for a one-time payment. That is Promotional Vehicle Wraps. If there’s something that offers complete freedom of design and durability, it is vehicle wraps. The benefits of getting a commercial van wrap are just too good for the price.

Our returning client, the owner of RockBottom Underpinning has been promoting his business by getting the business’s fleet vehicles wrapped in custom-designed wraps. Over the years, the client has realized how effective it is to have a vehicle drive around while showing off the brand.

Since it has been working for the client to get more customers, it made sense that he would want to do the same for a subsidiary named “RockBottom Basements”. In order to make people aware of this new business and services, the client decided to get a promotional van wrap for his company’s newest Ford Transit 250 High Roof Van.

He wanted a complete colour change from white to a hybrid between Satin Dark Basalt with a custom-designed portion. That shows the power of a custom vehicle wrap. From picking your favourite colour to getting your favourite design printed and then installed on your vehicle, there are no limits when it comes to getting a vinyl wrap.

Our design team worked with the client to first design the company logo, and then design the vehicle wrap. Once the client approved the mockup, we started the printing and installation process.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we value customer satisfaction above anything else, which is why we always use premium quality material supplied by Avery Dennison & 3M. To fully wrap this Ford Transit, we used the following materials:

  • White Printable Vinyl – Avery Dennison
  • Satin Dark Basalt – Avery Dennison (SW900-871)
  • Satin Laminate – Avery Dennison (1370Z)

We’ve attached pictures of the fully wrapped Ford Transit 250 for you to see how you can take your vision and put it on your vehicle.

If you have a vehicle that you want to turn into a moving billboard that advertises your business, learn about van wrap price, etc., give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our team members.
